_what: Declared exceptions to the 300-line-per-file rule enforced by lib/file-size-gate.js (run by `npm run validate`, guarded by tests/file-size-gate.test.js).
_rules: A file over the limit with no entry here FAILS the gate. That is the point: a new violation is distinguishable from a recorded one.
An entry for a file that is missing, or that is no longer over the limit, FAILS the gate, so this list cannot rot.
An entry with an empty reason FAILS the gate. The cost of an exception is writing down why.
An entry is added in the SAME change as the file that needs it, never as a later cleanup.
`lines_when_declared` is a dated observation, not a threshold. Nothing enforces it; it is here so a file that has since doubled is visible when the list is read.
_record: The full record behind these entries — path, length, code-vs-comment, category, disposition and the seam each deferred split would cut on — is WORK-TODO #10.
